content.comment_body: Hello, I am experiencing an issue with my operator panel. When I connect it to the [product_name], I get the message 'bm not respond.' Does anyone know what this message means and how to fix it? Thanks in advance.

Hi, This message usually appears when the cable between the [product_name] and the operator panel is disconnected or if there is a problem with the connection. Check your cable, the connectors, and related hardware.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing a communication error between the operator panel and the [product_name], shown as a 'bm not respond' message. The main usability issue is the insufficient feedback and troubleshooting support provided by the interface, leaving users uncertain about the cause of the problem and steps to resolve it.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the operator panel to connect reliably to the [product_name] and to receive clear and helpful feedback or error messages to resolve any connection issues.
